note: Bridge batch 1 (#401). In the model of STMT-TELEONOMY-CHANCE-INTENTION-DICHOTOMY the quinta via's other premises hold (natural bodies lack cognition, act regularly for the best, not by chance) while the chance-or-intention dichotomy fails. That is an objection to treating the dichotomy as forced by the observation, not a proof that it is false: the model does not identify random variation with chance in Aquinas' sense, nor broad intentio with conscious design (docs/teleonomy-comparison.md).
